also: put everything back in its place

phrases.latin: Lūdicra tua collige et in arcam repōne.
phrases.english: Pick up your toys and put them back in the box.
she must keep the house swept and clean

phrases.latin: Culīnam compōnāmus: suō quidque locō repōne.
phrases.english: Let’s tidy the kitchen: put everything back in its place.

phrases.latin: jam quidem in suō quicque locō nisi erit mihi situm supellectilis
phrases.english: unless every piece of furniture is set in its proper place for me now
